fontWeight: s.fontWeight,\n                        lineHeight: s.lineHeight,\n                        letterSpacing: s.letterSpacing,\n                        color: s.color,\n                        backgroundColor: s.backgroundColor,\n                        borderRadius: s.borderRadius,\n                        borderColor: s.borderColor,\n                        borderWidth: s.borderWidth,\n                        boxShadow: s.boxShadow\n                    };\n                };\n\n                // Amostragem de cores dominantes no DOM\n                const colors = new Set();\n                const bgColors = new Set();\n                const fontFamilies = new Set();\n                \n                const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\'body, header, nav, main, h1, h2, h3, p, a, button, [class*="card"], [class*="box"]\')).slice(0, 50);\n                elements.forEach(el => {\n                    const s = window.getComputedStyle(el);\n                    if (s.color) colors.add(s.color);\n                    if (s.backgroundColor && s.backgroundColor !== \'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)\') bgColors.add(s.backgroundColor);\n                    if (s.fontFamily) fontFamilies.add(s.fontFamily.split(\',\')[0].replace(/[\'"]/g, \'\').trim());\n                });\n\n                return {\n                    title: document.title,\n                    url: window.location.href,\n                    bodyStyles: getStyles(\'body\'),\n                    h1Styles: getStyles(\'h1\') || getStyles(\'h2\'),\n                    buttonStyles: getStyles(\'button\') || getStyles(\'a[class*="btn"]\'),\n                    sampleColors: Array.from(colors).slice(0, 10),\n                    sampleBgColors: Array.from(bgColors).slice(0, 8),\n                    fontFamilies: Array.from(fontFamilies).slice(0, 6)\n                };\n            }');
